definition_ja: 1 階線形微分方程式 y′ + P(x)y = Q(x) の両辺に掛けて、左辺を (μy)′ の形にする関数 μ(x) = e^{∫P(x)dx}。
definition_en: The function μ(x) = e^{∫P(x)dx} that turns the left side of y′ + P(x)y = Q(x) into (μy)′ when both sides are multiplied by it.
spoken_en: mu of x equals e to the integral of P of x dx

examples.en: Multiply both sides by the integrating factor, and the left side becomes a product rule in reverse.
examples.ja: 両辺に積分因子を掛けると、左辺は積の微分を逆にした形になる。

examples.en: Find an integrating factor for y′ − (1/x)y = x² and solve the equation.
examples.ja: y′ − (1/x)y = x² の積分因子を求め、方程式を解け。

pitfalls: 話し言葉はほとんどが MIT OCW（18.03）。
